image_title: Top Benefits of Effective Workplace Safety Programs
summary: The pie chart titled 'Top Benefits of Effective Workplace Safety Programs' illustrates the perceived advantages of workplace safety programs as reported by financial decisionmakers. The chart segments the benefits into categories based on the percentage of respondents who identified each benefit. 'Increased productivity' is the most recognized benefit, accounting for 43% of responses. 'Reduced costs' follows with 28%, while 'Other' benefits make up 16%. 'Greater retention of employees' and 'Better employee morale and greater job satisfaction' are noted by 7% and 6% of respondents, respectively. This visual representation highlights the prioritization of productivity and cost reduction as key outcomes of effective safety programs.
